items.title: How Met failed to stop rape-unit detective who abused women
items.summary: Warren Arter used his position - running a team investigating sexual assaults - to target women.

items.title: Prison sentence for teen e-biker who killed woman, 86, increased after appeal
items.summary: The prison sentence for a teen e-biker who killed an 86-year-old woman has been increased after an appeal.

items.title: Woman who accuses Russell Brand of rape says prison message 'upsetting'
items.summary: Mia Latter spoke to the BBC after the jailed comedian claimed he was innocent of offences against four other women, in comments on a podcast following his convction.

items.title: TGJones put up for sale in latest high street shake-up
items.summary: The high street chain which for more than two centuries traded under the WH Smith brand is being put up for sale just weeks before Christmas.

items.title: Cass report author tells BBC draft conversion practices bill is not workable
items.summary: The gender care review author says the bill’s wording risks "serious unintended consequences" for parents and therapists.

items.title: Nvidia creates national security committee after CEO's abrupt exit over alleged affairs
items.summary: Nvidia has established a new national security committee after its CEO resigned amid accusations of affairs with two employees and an alleged Chinese spy.
